note: Canonical legal/commercial risk register. Every risk maps to at least one official legal source, one accountable owner role, explicit required evidence and a release gate. No numerical probability is recorded: likelihoodStatus is qualitative or NOT_ASSESSED. A named legal requirement is not compliance; an open risk is never a legal clearance. No product is approved for commercial availability by this register.

risks.riskTitle: No per-SKU conformity assessment, declaration of conformity or technical file
risks.description: No MAREA product family has a completed conformity assessment route, EU declaration of conformity, technical documentation file, test report or notified-body outcome. The obligation is product- and SKU-specific; a design document or a component certificate is not evidence for the integrated product.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks lawful placing on the EU market for every hardware family and every bundle that includes hardware; no CE mark may be affixed or claimed.
requiredEvidence: Final product BOM and electrical schematic per SKU
EU declaration of conformity signed by the manufacturer
Traceability of manufacturer, importer and serial/lot
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits any CE, EMC, RED, LVD, conformity or certification claim in ES/EN copy and structured data.
risks.potentialRemediation: Commission a conformity programme per family after the hardware design freeze; use accredited laboratories; document the chosen conformity-assessment module and economic operator.

risks.riskTitle: Traceability and market-surveillance duties of importer/distributor are undefined
risks.description: EMBARCARTE has not decided whether it will be manufacturer, importer, distributor or all three for each supply model. Importer and distributor duties (verification of the manufacturer's conformity assessment, name and address on the product, storage and transport conditions, cooperation with authorities, corrective action) cannot be assigned until the role is chosen.
risks.commercialImpact: An unresolved role blocks market placement, supplier contracts and any claim that EMBARCARTE is or is not the responsible economic operator.
requiredEvidence: Written economic-operator decision per supply model
Supplier agreements naming the legal manufacturer
Importer identification and registered address on the product/packaging
risks.customerClaimImpact: No statement about who manufactures, imports or guarantees the product may be published before the role is decided.
risks.potentialRemediation: Adopt the economic-operator matrix in D04 and reflect it in supplier and distribution contracts.

risks.riskTitle: Spanish transposition and instruction-language obligations are unverified
risks.description: The Spanish RED transposition (Real Decreto 188/2016) and the related EMC/LVD transpositions were identified but, for the instruction-language and market-surveillance duties, not fully retrieved and verified. Assuming the Portuguese analogue applies is not evidence of Spanish law. Instructions and safety information must be in the language required by the Member State of sale.
risks.commercialImpact: A missing Spanish-language manual or wrong transposition reading blocks the Spanish market and can invalidate a future declaration of conformity.
requiredEvidence: Retrieved and cited consolidated text of RD 188/2016 and the EMC/LVD transpositions
Spanish-language instructions and safety information per product
Counsel memo on the applicable Spanish language and market-surveillance duties
risks.customerClaimImpact: Blocks Spanish-market publication and any statement that Spanish documentation is complete.
risks.potentialRemediation: Retrieve the BOE texts, have counsel confirm the duties and translate manuals before market placement.

risks.riskTitle: GPSR online-offer and traceability information duties are not implemented
risks.description: Under the General Product Safety Regulation, distance sellers and online marketplaces must present specified product-safety and traceability information and act on unsafe products. No MAREA product page, checkout or catalogue carries the manufacturer/importer identity, batch/serial traceability, warnings or recall channel required.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks online sales and creates exposure to withdrawal/recall orders and penalties.
requiredEvidence: Product-identification and traceability fields per SKU
risks.customerClaimImpact: Any online offer without traceability and safety information is prohibited.
risks.potentialRemediation: Design the product-data model with mandatory GPSR fields and gate publication on their presence.

risks.riskTitle: Product liability exposure under Directive (EU) 2024/2853 is not assessed
risks.description: The revised Product Liability Directive covers software and digital products, extends liable operators to importers, fulfilment service providers and authorised representatives, and introduces presumptions of defect and causation for technical complexity. No liability assessment exists for MAREA hardware, embedded software, SaaS or data services, and the Spanish transposition is not yet in force/verified.
risks.commercialImpact: Unlimited no-fault liability exposure for unsafe software/connected products; cannot be cured by disclaimers and is not covered by any confirmed insurance.
requiredEvidence: Counsel memo on PLD scope and Spanish transposition per product
Retention of technical documentation and update records
risks.customerClaimImpact: No statement that MAREA is safe, fit for navigation or free of liability exposure is permitted.
risks.potentialRemediation: Commission a liability assessment per family and align technical documentation and updates with the PLD evidence duties.

risks.riskTitle: CE marking is claimed or implied without a conformity route
risks.description: The programme's hard restriction CE_MARKING_CLAIM = PROHIBITED is not yet reflected in per-product rules. There is no conformity-assessment route, no declaration of conformity, no notified body and no test evidence; any CE marking, CE logo, 'CE compliant', 'EC declaration' or equivalent implication is prohibited.
risks.commercialImpact: An unauthorised CE claim is a market-surveillance and unfair-competition violation and can stop every product.
requiredEvidence: Signed EU declaration of conformity per product
risks.customerClaimImpact: CE/EMC/RED/LVD claims, logo use and conformity statements are prohibited in all channels and locales.
risks.potentialRemediation: Keep CE_MARKING_CLAIM prohibited until a completed conformity programme exists; encode the ban in the claims validator.

risks.riskTitle: Radio Equipment Directive applicability and radio conformity are not established
risks.description: AIS receivers, WATCH cellular devices, HUB Wi-Fi/Bluetooth and DISPLAY wireless modules may be radio equipment under Directive 2014/53/EU. No RED essential-requirements assessment, radio test report or notified-body involvement exists. The 2026 repeal of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/30 and the CRA transition must be read together, not assumed.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks radio-containing hardware from market placement and any spectrum/radio conformity claim.
requiredEvidence: Radio test reports and spectrum-use evidence
Current text of the 2026 delegated repeal measure
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'certified radio', 'RED compliant', 'CE radio' and spectrum claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Classify each wireless SKU, verify the consolidated RED and delegated acts current as of the assessment date, and test accordingly.

risks.riskTitle: AIS receive-only scope and spectrum authorisation boundary
risks.description: MAREA AIS is receive-only by design and hard restriction (AIS_TRANSMISSION_OFFERED = false). Receiving AIS still involves radio reception and antenna/splitter integration; transmitting AIS is a regulated maritime radio service that MAREA does not hold authorisation to offer. No radio licence, spectrum title or RF conformity evidence exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Any transmission offer would be an unlicensed radio service; even receive-only hardware needs RF conformity and correct installation warnings.
requiredEvidence: Radio conformity evidence for the receiver
Written confirmation that no transmission capability is shipped
risks.customerClaimImpact: AIS transmission, transponder, DSC, collision-avoidance and 'see all traffic' claims are prohibited absolutely.
risks.potentialRemediation: Keep receive-only scope; test receiver conformity; document antenna isolation and no-transmit evidence.

risks.riskTitle: Website and distance-selling information duties are incomplete
risks.description: LSSI, the eCommerce Directive and consumer law require the seller's legal identity, registered address, contact details, clear price information including taxes and delivery costs, precontractual information, and accessible terms. The current site's SITE.legal fields (taxId, address, registry) are empty and the commerce surface presents sample purchasable products.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks lawful online sale in Spain and the EU; sanctions and consumer cancellation rights can apply.
requiredEvidence: Verified company legal identity and tax ID
Published legal notice, terms and privacy policy
Price, tax and delivery-cost disclosure rules
risks.customerClaimImpact: No checkout, price or availability CTA may be published while the seller identity and terms are incomplete.
risks.potentialRemediation: Complete SITE.legal from company registration data, publish the legal pack and gate commerce CTAs on it.

risks.riskTitle: Environmental producer responsibility (WEEE, RoHS, Batteries, Packaging) is not registered or evidenced
risks.description: Placing electrical/electronic equipment, batteries and packaged goods on the Spanish market triggers producer-registration, take-back, marking and reporting duties. No registration, take-back scheme, RoHS declaration or battery/packaging compliance evidence exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks placing hardware on the Spanish market and creates registration/reporting penalties.
requiredEvidence: Packaging compliance declaration and EPR registration
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits environmental, recyclability or 'sustainable' claims without evidence.
risks.potentialRemediation: Register with the Spanish producer responsibility schemes before first placement and collect supplier declarations.

risks.riskTitle: PILOT safety gate remains blocked with no safety case, bench evidence or sea trials
risks.description: PILOT is a supervised steering product whose safety case, E-stop, motor isolation, rudder feedback, takeover detection and sea trials do not exist in evidence. The hard restriction PILOT_SAFETY_GATE = BLOCKED must hold regardless of any commercial or financial scenario.
risks.commercialImpact: PILOT cannot be sold, pre-sold, demonstrated as safe or included as a purchasable bundle component.
requiredEvidence: Independent hazard analysis and safety case
Physical E-stop and fail-closed relay evidence
risks.customerClaimImpact: No autonomy, unattended steering, remote helm, collision avoidance or safety claim may ever be approved for PILOT in the current state.
risks.potentialRemediation: Fund the staged safety programme; keep the product unsellable and all copy in supervised-only language until the gate closes.

risks.riskTitle: PILOT/HUB control plane is unauthenticated and unhardened
risks.description: The on-board autopilot HTTP command API has been evidenced as unauthenticated, bound to 0.0.0.0 with permissive CORS, exposing engage, e-stop, drive-test and tuning commands on the LAN. This is both a safety and a cybersecurity defect for any connected HUB/PILOT configuration.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks any networked HUB/PILOT field use and any security claim.
requiredEvidence: Authenticated command API design and test
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'secure', 'hardened', 'protected against intrusion' or remote-control claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Authenticate and bind the control plane locally, add command audit and interlock, and re-test before any field use.

risks.riskTitle: AIS receiver RF/EMC conformity, antenna integration and performance evidence absent
risks.description: No receiver hardware selection, RF front-end evidence, antenna/splitter integration assessment, EMC pre-scan or reception performance measurement exists. A third-party module certificate would not certify the integrated MAREA product.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks AIS market placement and any reception-range or compatibility claim.
requiredEvidence: Selected receiver module with supplier conformity evidence
Measured reception report in a stated installation and sea state
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'nm range', 'sees all traffic', 'professional receiver' and EMC claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Select a certified receiver module, run system-level conformity and measured reception tests, publish limits honestly.

risks.riskTitle: NMEA 2000 is not implemented and no NMEA certification or licence is held
risks.description: NMEA 2000 support exists only as type stubs; no manufacturer/product code, membership/licence, protocol conformance test or certification exists. Read-only interoperability is not certification. Any 'NMEA 2000 certified' or equivalent claim is prohibited.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks NMEA 2000 interface sales and any certification claim; creates trademark/licence exposure.
requiredEvidence: Implemented and tested NMEA 2000 stack or explicit scope exclusion
risks.customerClaimImpact: NMEA 2000 certified, compliant, approved and universal interoperability claims are prohibited.
risks.potentialRemediation: Decide NMEA 2000 participation (licence + certification) or reduce scope to NMEA 0183/Signal K with tested evidence.

risks.riskTitle: NMEA 0183 interoperability is untested
risks.description: No tested NMEA 0183 sentence matrix (direction, baud, message set, firmware version) exists. Compatibility statements are conditional and cannot be published as validated.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks compatibility statements and installed-system quotations.
requiredEvidence: Tested NMEA 0183 matrix per device and firmware
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'compatible with NMEA 0183' without a tested matrix row.
risks.potentialRemediation: Build a compatibility test harness and publish only measured rows.

risks.riskTitle: No physical prototype, EMC pre-scan, environmental or electrical evidence
risks.description: No MAREA hardware family has a physical build, thermal/ingress measurement, EMC pre-scan, electrical safety test or environmental qualification record. Design intent and public datasheets are not product evidence.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks all hardware market placement and every physical-performance claim.
requiredEvidence: EMC pre-scan and full test reports
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits IP rating, ruggedness, temperature, reliability and 'tested at sea' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Build prototypes and run the qualification plan before any hardware claim.

risks.riskTitle: WATCH alert delivery, offshore coverage and monitoring availability are not demonstrated
risks.description: WATCH depends on cellular connectivity, a cloud alert pipeline and device identity that do not exist as tested services. Offshore coverage cannot be guaranteed; alerts may be delayed or lost. No SLA or measured delivery evidence exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks WATCH/PROTECT/FLEET promises and any alert-delivery or availability claim.
requiredEvidence: Connectivity contract and coverage test report
Alert pipeline test with delivery log
risks.customerClaimImpact: Guaranteed alert delivery, continuous offshore monitoring, 24/7 monitoring and safety-of-life claims are prohibited absolutely.
risks.potentialRemediation: Build and test the service end-to-end, state real coverage limits, and publish no guarantee until measured.

risks.riskTitle: SENSE measurement accuracy and calibration are not measured
risks.description: SENSE wind, power, bilge, tank and environment modules are defined but have no sensor selection, calibration procedure evidence, accuracy measurement or ingress verification. Incorrect measurements can mislead operational decisions.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks accuracy, precision, calibration and 'reliable measurement' claims.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits accuracy percentages, 'precision', 'certified measurement' and safety-alarm claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Select sensors, measure accuracy, document calibration and state limits truthfully.

risks.riskTitle: DISPLAY hardware, enclosure, sunlight readability and embedded runtime are not selected
risks.description: DISPLAY size, panel, enclosure, ingress protection, sunlight readability, power and embedded/kiosk runtime are not frozen. A browser prototype is not an embedded marine display.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks DISPLAY market placement, size claims and installed quotations.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits sunlight-readable, IP-rated, MFD-class and size claims before evidence.
risks.potentialRemediation: Freeze hardware and validate it; keep DISPLAY out of purchasable bundles until then.

risks.riskTitle: FLEET SaaS, tenant isolation, billing and SLA are not demonstrated
risks.description: FLEET is a multi-tenant B2B SaaS with no implemented tenant isolation test, no billing/entitlement engine, no SLA measurement and no vessel-control path by design. A B2B service contract and data-processing terms do not exist.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks FLEET sales, B2B SLA statements and any tenant-isolation or security assurance.
requiredEvidence: Implemented tenancy model with authorisation tests
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits SLA, uptime, 'secure multi-tenant', ISO/SOC and guaranteed availability claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Build and test the SaaS controls before offering FLEET; publish no SLA until measured.

risks.riskTitle: OPEN-MARINE ownership chain is undocumented and licence is absent
risks.description: The OPEN-MARINE repository has no LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE and its custody is a personal account. Default copyright gives EMBARCARTE no proven inbound right to reuse or redistribute the code and gives customers no outbound right. Repository custody and Git author emails are not ownership evidence.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks distribution of any OPEN-MARINE-derived software, firmware or SaaS and therefore every software-bearing product.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits any ownership, copyright, licence or 'open' claim about the underlying code.
risks.potentialRemediation: Complete the assignment chain, adopt an explicit outbound licence and document contributor rights.

risks.riskTitle: Contributor IP assignments and employer rights are missing
risks.description: Roughly half of OPEN-MARINE files were last touched by a corporate-domain contributor without a CLA/DCO or documented employer relationship. The employer may own the work; neither EMBARCARTE nor the project holds a proven licence.
risks.commercialImpact: Unassigned contributor rights can invalidate the distribution licence and expose the programme to takedown or injunction.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits ownership and originality claims about the code.
risks.potentialRemediation: Obtain written assignments/waivers; freeze work in disputed files until cleared.

risks.riskTitle: Entity ownership between individual, TECNORIA and EMBARCARTE is undocumented
risks.description: Ownership of the code between the individual custodian, a company-style contributor domain and EMBARCARTE is not documented. No corporate IP schedule or repository transfer exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Without an entity-level assignment, EMBARCARTE cannot prove it may commercialise the technology.
requiredEvidence: Repository transfer to an EMBARCARTE-controlled organisation
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits any statement that EMBARCARTE owns the technology.
risks.potentialRemediation: Document ownership and transfer or license the repository to EMBARCARTE.

risks.riskTitle: Pre-history provenance of the root commit is undocumented
risks.description: The root commit already contained hundreds of files and the pre-history provenance is undocumented. Code may have been copied from another project without a licence.
risks.commercialImpact: Provenance gaps can invalidate the licence chain and force code removal.
requiredEvidence: Code-scan comparison against public sources with review
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits originality and 'no third-party code' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Run a provenance review and obtain written declarations.

risks.riskTitle: AI-assisted code and asset provenance is unrecorded
risks.description: AI-generated commits and media assets lack a recorded tool-usage policy or provenance. Copyright status of AI-assisted output and the licence terms of the tools are not documented.
risks.commercialImpact: Unclear provenance can create infringement and disclosure exposure in distributed product and marketing assets.
requiredEvidence: Replacement or clearance of unprovenanced media
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits claims of human authorship or originality for unprovenanced assets.
risks.potentialRemediation: Adopt an AI provenance policy and record every tool and asset source.

risks.riskTitle: Third-party notices bundle is absent for software distribution
risks.description: No NOTICE bundle exists for the software inventory although Apache-2.0, CC-BY, BlueOak and public-domain components require notice/attribution in external distributions. Firmware and container notices are also unverified.
risks.commercialImpact: Distribution without notices breaches licence terms and can suspend the right to distribute.
requiredEvidence: Generated third-party notices bundle per release artefact
Notice build step in the release pipeline
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits claims that all notices are included before the bundle exists.
risks.potentialRemediation: Automate NOTICE generation and gate releases on it.

risks.riskTitle: Provider tiles and configuration remain in public Git history
risks.description: Thousands of cached provider tiles and configuration remain retrievable in the public Git history after de-tracking. Their retention and redistribution position is unresolved and may conflict with provider terms.
risks.commercialImpact: Could require history rewrite or retention notice; may breach provider terms during diligence.
requiredEvidence: Legal opinion on history rewrite vs notice
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits claims that all data was removed from public history.
risks.potentialRemediation: Assess each provider's terms and decide on a documented retention/rewrite position.

risks.riskTitle: Contributor governance (CLA/DCO, CONTRIBUTING) is absent
risks.description: Future contributions have no CLA, DCO or Signed-off-by policy, so the ownership chain will keep degrading as code is added.
risks.commercialImpact: Ongoing contributions without assignments weaken future IP clearance.
risks.customerClaimImpact: None directly; supports ownership claims indirectly.
risks.potentialRemediation: Adopt a DCO/CLA policy before accepting external code.

risks.riskTitle: OPEN-MARINE/OMI naming rights are undecided
risks.description: OPEN-MARINE/OMI has no trademark record and custody is personal. Whether it is an internal codename or a commercial name is undecided; using it publicly may create prior-rights exposure.
risks.commercialImpact: Possible opposition or rebranding cost if used as a commercial mark.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits presenting OPEN-MARINE as a registered or licensed commercial brand.
risks.potentialRemediation: Keep OPEN-MARINE internal-only until a naming decision and clearance exist.

risks.riskTitle: GPL-3.0 AIS-catcher distribution and combined-work analysis
risks.description: AIS-catcher (GPL-3.0) is downloaded or compiled at setup and intended to run inside the appliance. Shipping it triggers source-provision, notice and combined-work analysis; it is not version-pinned or checksum-verified.
risks.commercialImpact: GPL source-provision obligations could apply to the appliance distribution; non-compliance can terminate the redistribution right.
requiredEvidence: Corresponding source and written offer if shipping
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits describing the software as proprietary or fully closed-source while GPL components ship.
risks.potentialRemediation: Choose the decoder strategy and implement full GPL compliance or replace the component.

risks.riskTitle: Firmware/dependency pinning, digest integrity and SBOM are absent
risks.description: Firmware runtimes and container images are not digest-pinned, external binaries are installed without hash verification, and no SBOM or licence gate exists in CI. Distribution integrity and licence compliance are unproven.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks release evidence and weakens both IP notices and CRA vulnerability handling.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits claims of supply-chain integrity or reproducible builds.
risks.potentialRemediation: Pin digests, generate SBOMs and add a licence/integrity gate to CI.

risks.riskTitle: Unknown-licence dependency and first-party licence inconsistency
risks.description: One dependency has no identifiable licence; several first-party package manifests omit licence metadata and one declares an inconsistent ISC licence. The outbound position is therefore not reflected in the artefacts.
risks.commercialImpact: A licence-less dependency may not be distributable; inconsistent metadata undermines due diligence.
requiredEvidence: Replacement or licence clarification for the unknown package
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits claims that all dependencies are licence-cleared.
risks.potentialRemediation: Remove or clarify the unknown package and align manifests with the chosen outbound licence.

risks.riskTitle: MAREA trademark legal clearance is not granted
risks.description: No EU or Spanish registration or clearance search exists for MAREA and the mark is used only as a proposed brand. TRADEMARK_LEGAL_CLEARANCE = NOT_GRANTED is a hard restriction. A prior-user signal ('Marea Marine') was recorded as a risk indicator, not as an infringement finding.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks public brand use, packaging, trademark claims and any brand-derived valuation or pricing.
requiredEvidence: Counsel opinion on registrability and prior rights
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits ®, ™, 'registered', 'official brand' and any MAREA public-use assertion; MAREA_PUBLIC_USE = NO_GO must prevail.
risks.potentialRemediation: Commission clearance before any public use; keep the proposed-brand status explicit in all internal documents.

risks.riskTitle: Inherited MC-03 class-A claim conflicts with MAREA public-use NO-GO
risks.description: MC-03's claims policy classifies 'MAREA is a product brand of EMBARCARTE' as Class A (allowed today) and permits naming/edition statements in internal contexts, while the active decision is MAREA_PUBLIC_USE = NO_GO because trademark clearance is NOT_GRANTED. The inherited policy does not distinguish internal naming from public trademark use sharply enough. The stricter gate must prevail; MC-03 evidence is not edited by MC-14.
risks.commercialImpact: An inherited A-class public claim could authorise unlawful trademark use and expose the programme to opposition and unfair-competition claims.
requiredEvidence: MC-14 override/supersession proposal recorded in DECISION-LOG
Approval decision by the brand owner and counsel
Explicit internal-vs-public claim gates in the machine-readable contract
risks.customerClaimImpact: Public 'MAREA is a product brand of EMBARCARTE' and any MAREA-named public surface remain prohibited; internal documentation may use the internal name only.
risks.potentialRemediation: Record the conflict and the stricter MC-14 rule; update the brand contract only through the approved supersession decision.

risks.riskTitle: Official chart/ENC distribution rights are not granted
risks.description: No IHM/IHPT or IC-ENC distributor or OEM agreement exists; no S-63 OEM status, per-cell permit or end-user EULA. NAV cannot claim official charts, offline official regions or ECDIS-like status.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks NAV chart features and the NAV/CRUISE/SAIL/COMPLETE value proposition as currently described.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'official charts', 'ENC included', 'ECDIS-class', 'navigation-grade charts' and offline-region claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Decide the chart strategy and contract with IHM/IC-ENC or restrict NAV to user-supplied charts with explicit disclaimers.

risks.riskTitle: Weather data commercial rights are not granted
risks.description: Open-Meteo's free API is non-commercial; subscriptions require a paid plan or AGPL self-hosting. AEMET NWP outputs are not open data, MeteoGalicia terms were unreachable, and Puertos del Estado warns against third-party transfer. No redistribution, offline-cache or paid-product right is held.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks WEATHER as a paid product and weather layers in NAV/DISPLAY/FLEET.
requiredEvidence: Signed provider licence for commercial use
Territory, cache, offline and redistribution rights schedule
Written terms from each public-sector provider
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'licensed forecasts', 'official weather', forecast-accuracy and offline-weather claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Choose a licensed provider or documented self-hosting route and contract it before WEATHER publication.

risks.riskTitle: Basemap and tile rights (OSM, Esri, OpenWeather) are unresolved
risks.description: OSM tile policy forbids bulk/offline prefetch and can withdraw commercial access; Esri World Imagery is fetched without an ArcGIS account; OpenWeather map/tile layers are a separate paid SKU. No production right exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks offline basemaps and any tile-backed paid feature; terms can be withdrawn without notice.
requiredEvidence: Tile provider licence or self-hosted licensed stack
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'offline maps' and 'satellite imagery' claims before rights exist.
risks.potentialRemediation: Replace with self-hosted openly licensed tiles or contract a licensed provider.

risks.riskTitle: Bathymetry and contextual layers are restricted to informational use
risks.description: GEBCO allows commercial use but forbids navigation use; EMODnet bathymetry is not a nautical chart; one repository source is mislabelled CC-BY-NC. Presenting them as navigation data would be misleading.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks navigation-grade presentation of bathymetry; creates mislabelling exposure.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits bathymetry-as-chart and 'navigation-grade' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Relabel sources, restrict to contextual use and display provenance.

risks.riskTitle: Marine-data attribution, provenance and freshness display obligations are not implemented
risks.description: Provider terms require attribution and the programme's own claims policy requires source, timestamp and stale state for every displayed data point. No data-provenance UI, metadata or stale-state handling is evidenced.
risks.commercialImpact: Missing attribution breaches provider terms; missing provenance makes data claims misleading.
requiredEvidence: Data-source register surfaced in the product
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits data claims without displayed provenance and freshness.
risks.potentialRemediation: Implement provenance metadata and UI before publishing any data-backed feature.

risks.riskTitle: AIS-derived data retention and redistribution policy is undecided
risks.description: History, fleet sharing and any redistribution of AIS-derived traffic are not established. AIS reception is receive-only and must never be presented as collision avoidance or transponder capability.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks AIS-history features and FLEET traffic analytics; creates privacy and data-rights exposure.
requiredEvidence: License review of AIS data use
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits traffic-history, fleet-intelligence and collision-avoidance claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Document a conservative retention/no-redistribution policy with counsel before enabling any AIS-derived feature.

risks.riskTitle: B2C precontractual information and terms are incomplete
risks.description: Consumer distance selling requires identity, address, total price with taxes, delivery costs, withdrawal information, complaint handling and terms in durable form before ordering. No approved consumer terms of sale, withdrawal form or precontractual information set exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks lawful online B2C sales and can extend withdrawal periods.
requiredEvidence: Counsel-reviewed consumer terms of sale ES/EN
risks.customerClaimImpact: No purchase CTA until terms and precontractual information are published.
risks.potentialRemediation: Draft and counsel-review the B2C pack; gate checkout on publication.

risks.riskTitle: Commercial warranty could be presented as replacing mandatory legal guarantee
risks.description: Spanish law grants consumers a 3-year legal guarantee with a 24-month presumption of non-conformity at delivery. An optional commercial warranty must not replace or shorten the legal rights, and the statutory guarantees must be stated accurately. The 3% returns allowance in the financial model is not a measured return rate.
risks.commercialImpact: Invalid or misleading warranty terms create unfair-contract and consumer claims and can extend seller liability.
requiredEvidence: Separation of legal rights and commercial warranty
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'lifetime warranty', 'replaces legal guarantee', shortened-guarantee and 'reliability' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Draft warranty terms that expressly preserve statutory rights and avoid discretionary reductions.

risks.riskTitle: Withdrawal-right information and digital-content exceptions are undocumented
risks.description: The 14-day withdrawal right, its exceptions for sealed goods and digital content supplied immediately with consent, and the consequences of withdrawal are not described in approved ES/EN terms. Suppressing the right without valid justification is prohibited.
risks.commercialImpact: Missing withdrawal information extends the period to 12 months; incorrect exceptions are unenforceable.
requiredEvidence: Withdrawal information and form in ES/EN
Consent flow for immediate digital supply
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'no returns', 'final sale' and 'no withdrawal right' statements without a valid legal basis.
risks.potentialRemediation: Add the statutory withdrawal information and consent flows to the consumer terms.

risks.riskTitle: Digital content/service conformity, updates and portability duties are not mapped
risks.description: NAV/WEATHER/FLEET subscriptions and firmware updates are digital content/services. The Digital Content Directive and the Sale of Goods Directive impose conformity, update and remedy duties, including updates during the period the consumer may expect. No update policy, remedy matrix or data-export commitment exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Unclear update duties and service termination can breach conformity obligations and block subscription sales.
requiredEvidence: Digital content terms and update policy
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'lifetime access', 'free forever', 'guaranteed updates' and indefinite-support claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Draft the digital-service terms with update and termination commitments consistent with the CRA support-period decision.

risks.riskTitle: B2B sales terms are absent
risks.description: No B2B supply terms exist (delivery, risk, retention of title, payment, conformity, remedies, liability caps, force majeure, applicable law). B2B and B2C cannot share one template without justification because mandatory consumer rules do not apply and commercial freedom differs.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks B2B supply, distributor and installers' channel contracts.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits quoting B2B customers under consumer assumptions.
risks.potentialRemediation: Draft a B2B contract set separate from the consumer terms.

risks.riskTitle: Installer and distributor agreements are absent
risks.description: No installer agreement defines installation responsibility, commissioning records, electrical/marine safety duties, warranty allocation or liability. No distributor agreement defines territory, pricing, service obligations or conformity cooperation.
risks.commercialImpact: Installation defects and unclear responsibility create liability and warranty exposure.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'certified installer' claims until a real certification scheme exists.
risks.potentialRemediation: Draft installer/distributor terms and a commissioning record before any channel sale.

risks.riskTitle: Subscription renewal, cancellation and refund mechanics are absent
risks.description: Renewal, cancellation, price changes, refunds and what becomes inaccessible after expiry are not defined. The current website explains subscriptions only partially; the financial model assumes renewal rates that are not validated.
risks.commercialImpact: Unclear renewal terms block subscription sales and create consumer claims.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'cancel anytime', 'no commitment' and 'lifetime data access' without matching terms.
risks.potentialRemediation: Write the subscription contract and implement the mechanics before selling any plan.

risks.riskTitle: Returns, RMA and repair workflow are absent
risks.description: No return merchandise authorisation process, repair/replacement decision tree, shipping-cost allocation or SLA exists. The 3% returns allowance is an illustrative financial assumption, not a measured rate.
risks.commercialImpact: Without a returns process the seller cannot meet statutory remedies and the cost model is unverified.
requiredEvidence: Measured failure/return data or explicit UNKNOWN
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits return-rate, reliability and 'no-hassle returns' claims without measured evidence.
risks.potentialRemediation: Define the RMA process and keep return-rate assumptions labelled as unknown until measured.

risks.riskTitle: Mixed hardware-plus-service bundle characterisation is undecided
risks.description: START/CRUISE/SAIL/PROTECT/COMPLETE/FLEET combine goods, digital content and services. The applicable conformity regime, withdrawal treatment, termination and refund calculation for a mixed contract are not defined.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks bundle sales and creates refund/termination disputes.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits presenting bundled subscriptions as one indivisible product where that changes consumer rights.
risks.potentialRemediation: Define bundle contract mechanics with counsel before bundle sale.

risks.riskTitle: Controller/processor roles for telemetry and FLEET are undecided
risks.description: EMBARCARTE's role (controller, joint controller, processor) differs by processing purpose and customer type. FLEET is a B2B multi-tenant service where EMBARCARTE may act as processor for fleet data while remaining controller for account and billing. No role decision or Article 28 agreement exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks FLEET onboarding and any privacy statement; role confusion creates joint liability.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'GDPR compliant', 'data processor only' and privacy-assurance claims before the agreements exist.
risks.potentialRemediation: Adopt the role map and DPA before onboarding any FLEET customer.

risks.riskTitle: DPIA for vessel location tracking and monitoring is not performed
risks.description: Location tracking, remote monitoring, alert destinations and fleet telemetry may involve systematic monitoring of individuals at sea and identifiable owners/crew. A DPIA screening and, if required, a full DPIA has not been performed; AEPD guidance was inaccessible during predecessor research.
risks.commercialImpact: Processing without a DPIA where required can be unlawful and lead to AEPD sanctions.
requiredEvidence: AEPD consultation where residual risk remains high
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits privacy-by-design, 'anonymised telemetry' and 'no personal data' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Perform the DPIA before any WATCH/FLEET processing and consult the AEPD when required.

risks.riskTitle: Processor agreements and subprocessor chain are absent
risks.description: FLEET would use cloud, SMS/email, payment and connectivity providers as subprocessors. No Article 28 processor agreement, transfer assessment or subprocessor list exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks lawful outsourced processing and FLEET onboarding.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits claims that data is processed exclusively in the EU without evidence.
risks.potentialRemediation: Contract processors and document the subprocessor chain before processing customer data.

risks.riskTitle: Lawful basis and transparency for telemetry and location are unassigned
risks.description: No lawful basis (contract, legitimate interest, consent) is assigned per processing purpose, and no layered privacy notice covers vessel owners, crew, guests and alert recipients. Location monitoring requires clear transparency.
risks.commercialImpact: Unlawful processing basis and missing notice block launch and create complaint exposure.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'anonymous', 'no tracking' and 'privacy-first' claims without evidence.
risks.potentialRemediation: Complete the purpose matrix and notices before processing.

risks.riskTitle: Retention, deletion and export schedule for marine data is absent
risks.description: No retention period, deletion procedure or export mechanism exists for telemetry, track history, alerts, account data and device identifiers. Data-subject rights cannot be fulfilled without it.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks FLEET and WATCH operation; creates storage-limitation breaches.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'delete anytime', 'full data export' and 'no retention' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Define retention and implement deletion/export before collecting data.

risks.riskTitle: Data-subject rights, access segregation and breach management are not implemented
risks.description: No process exists for access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability or objection; no tenant access segregation test; no Article 33 breach notification runbook or 72-hour procedure.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks FLEET sales and creates regulatory exposure on any incident.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits claims of GDPR compliance or certified security.
risks.potentialRemediation: Implement rights handling, isolation tests and the breach runbook before launch.

risks.riskTitle: Cookie/ePrivacy consent and analytics are unassessed on the existing site
risks.description: The existing website must obtain prior consent for non-essential cookies and tracking and must provide clear cookie information. No evidence of a compliant consent mechanism, cookie inventory or tag governance exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Unlawful tracking and missing consent expose the site to AEPD action and undermine trust.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits privacy-respecting and no-tracking claims without evidence.
risks.potentialRemediation: Implement consent mode and publish the cookie policy before any tracking.

risks.riskTitle: CRA applicability and product classification are unconfirmed
risks.description: Connected products with digital elements fall under Regulation (EU) 2024/2847. Whether each MAREA family is a default, important (Annex III) or critical (Annex IV) product, and the resulting conformity-assessment route, is not established. The reporting obligations already apply from 2026-09-11.
risks.commercialImpact: Misclassification can invalidate the conformity route and block market placement from 2027-12-11.
requiredEvidence: CRA scope and classification memo per family
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'CRA compliant', 'cybersecurity certified' and 'EU cyber-approved' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Classify each product and design the compliance route with counsel/notified body.

risks.riskTitle: Secure development lifecycle is not established
risks.description: No secure-by-design and secure-by-default development process, threat modelling, code review, dependency scanning or security testing is documented for firmware, appliance images or the SaaS.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks CRA conformity and weakens product liability defences.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'secure by design' claims unless the process exists.
risks.potentialRemediation: Adopt an SSDLC and apply it to the firmware and SaaS.

risks.riskTitle: Vulnerability intake, disclosure and remediation process is absent
risks.description: No coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy, security contact, intake channel, triage process, remediation timeline or advisory publication exists as required by the CRA.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks CRA compliance and leaves the product without a lawful vulnerability-handling route.
requiredEvidence: Published CVD policy and security contact
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'no known vulnerabilities', 'prompt patching' and bug-bounty claims without a real process.
risks.potentialRemediation: Publish a CVD policy and operate the intake/triage process before market placement.

risks.riskTitle: Security update and support period are undecided
risks.description: The CRA requires a support period determined by the manufacturer and set with regard to the expected product lifetime. No support period, update-distribution mechanism or end-of-support policy exists. The 5-year figure in the financial model is an assumption, not a legal guarantee.
risks.commercialImpact: Without a support-period decision, update promises and product lifetime claims are unsupported.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'updates for X years', 'lifetime updates' and 'guaranteed support' claims not backed by the policy.
risks.potentialRemediation: Decide and publish the support period; implement update delivery and end-of-support notice.

risks.riskTitle: SBOM, dependency maintenance and firmware controls are absent
risks.description: No SBOM, dependency-vulnerability monitoring, secure boot, signed firmware, rollback protection or secure configuration baseline exists for any device family.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks CRA conformity and device-security claims.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'tamper-proof', 'secure boot' and 'hardened device' claims absent evidence.
risks.potentialRemediation: Implement SBOM and firmware security controls before market placement.

risks.riskTitle: CRA incident-reporting process is absent although reporting duties already apply
risks.description: CRA Article 14 reporting of actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents applies from 2026-09-11. No process, contact point, 24-hour early warning or 72-hour notification capability exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Non-reporting is a present compliance breach for products already in scope; blocks any placement.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'incident-free', 'no breaches' and 'fully protected' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Stand up the reporting process immediately and test it before any connected product is placed.

risks.riskTitle: Device identity, provisioning, authentication and access control are absent
risks.description: No device identity, secure onboarding/ownership transfer, user authentication, role model, session security or remote-access policy exists for HUB/WATCH/FLEET/DISPLAY.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks connected product sales and security assurances.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'bank-level security', 'secure login' and 'role-based access' claims without tests.
risks.potentialRemediation: Design and test identity/provisioning before connecting devices to cloud services.

risks.riskTitle: No merchant/payment-provider agreement or approved checkout exists
risks.description: The programme intends a hosted/tokenised payment model, but no merchant agreement, onboarding, settlement account, refund capability or chargeback procedure exists. MC-13's card fee is a published tariff, not a contract.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks any checkout, subscription collection and refund; no revenue can be lawfully collected.
requiredEvidence: PCI-scope confirmation for the hosted model
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'buy now', 'subscribe', payment-method and secure-payment claims until the agreement exists.
risks.potentialRemediation: Select a hosted/tokenised provider, complete onboarding and document the payment policy.

risks.riskTitle: PSD2/SCA applicability and payment-provider roles are unassessed
risks.description: Whether EMBARCARTE acts as merchant, payee, technical service provider or agent and which strong-customer-authentication exemptions apply is not assessed. A hosted/tokenised model reduces but does not automatically remove scope.
risks.commercialImpact: Wrong role analysis can invalidate the payment flow and create regulatory exposure.
requiredEvidence: Provider contract clauses on liability and chargebacks
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits '3-D Secure', 'SCA-compliant' and 'secure payment' claims before implementation.
risks.potentialRemediation: Have counsel confirm the role and SCA model with the provider.

risks.riskTitle: Refund, chargeback and fraud exposure is undefined
risks.description: Refund timing, chargeback liability, fraud screening and reserve requirements are not agreed with any provider and are not modelled. Consumer law imposes refund rules that the process cannot currently meet.
risks.commercialImpact: Unbudgeted chargebacks and refund delays create cash and consumer-law exposure.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'instant refunds', 'money-back guarantee' and chargeback-free claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Agree the refund/chargeback regime with the provider and implement the workflow.

risks.riskTitle: Subscription billing disclosures and renewal notices are not implemented
risks.description: The checkout and account flows must disclose renewal terms, price, billing frequency and cancellation before the consumer is bound, and must send renewal reminders where required. No approved flow exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Non-compliant renewal flows can be challenged and refunded; blocks subscription launch.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'cancel anytime' and 'no commitment' without matching mechanics.
risks.potentialRemediation: Design and test the billing disclosures before enabling subscriptions.

risks.riskTitle: VAT, OSS, import VAT and customs treatment are unconfirmed
risks.description: The model assumes 21% Spanish VAT, B2C VAT-inclusive pricing and OSS, but cross-border B2C rates, B2B reverse charge, import VAT/customs on hardware from outside the EU and invoice content are not professionally confirmed. Hardware provenance and Incoterms are unknown.
risks.commercialImpact: Mis-stated VAT or customs treatment can make every advertised price wrong and create tax liabilities.
requiredEvidence: Tax adviser confirmation per supply model
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits final-price, tax-inclusive and 'all taxes included' claims until confirmed.
risks.potentialRemediation: Obtain professional tax confirmation and implement locale-aware price display.

risks.riskTitle: Electrical fault, overheating or fire liability
risks.description: Marine electrical installations and lithium/lead-acid interactions can cause fire or shock if a HUB/SENSE/DISPLAY/PILOT installation is defective. No electrical safety evidence, fuse/breaker specification or installation limits exist.
risks.commercialImpact: Uninsured personal-injury and property-damage exposure; blocks electrical claims.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'safe', 'fireproof', 'protected' and IP-rating claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Test electrical safety, document installation limits and require installer competence.

risks.riskTitle: Installation defect liability
risks.description: Installation by third parties can cause water ingress, electrical faults, interference or loss of function. No installer agreement, competence requirement, commissioning record or responsibility matrix exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Unclear installer responsibility creates warranty and liability disputes.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'certified installation' and 'warranty covers installation' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Contract installers and require a signed commissioning record.

risks.riskTitle: Product malfunction liability
risks.description: Failure of a navigation aid or monitoring device can cause economic loss, grounding or injury. No reliability data, failure-mode analysis or software-update rollback evidence exists.
risks.commercialImpact: Latent defect exposure across every hardware unit; no insurance cover confirmed.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'reliable', 'no downtime' and MTBF claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Run reliability/FMEA work and define the update/rollback policy.

risks.riskTitle: Incorrect sensor measurement liability
risks.description: Wrong depth, wind, tank or bilge readings can mislead navigation or maintenance decisions. Accuracy is not measured and calibration is not documented.
risks.commercialImpact: Measurement-error claims and consequential loss; blocks accuracy advertising.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits accuracy percentages and 'safety alarm' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Measure accuracy and publish tolerances and limits.

risks.riskTitle: AIS reception limitation liability
risks.description: AIS is incomplete by nature: not all vessels transmit, reception depends on antenna and range, and Class B/low-power units may be missed. Over-reliance can contribute to collision. The product is receive-only and not collision avoidance.
risks.commercialImpact: Safety expectations created by copy can increase liability; no insurance confirmed.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits collision-avoidance, 'guaranteed detection' and 'see all vessels' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Embed the mandatory AIS disclaimer and document limits.

risks.riskTitle: Chart and navigation data error liability
risks.description: Charts, bathymetry and position data can be wrong, stale or mis-scaled. Presenting them as navigation-grade without licensed official ENC creates liability if a grounding or accident occurs.
risks.commercialImpact: Uncapped liability exposure; blocks navigation claims and official-chart positioning.
requiredEvidence: Licensed chart rights or explicit user-supplied-chart model
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits official-chart, ECDIS, 'safe navigation' and 'prevents grounding' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Restrict to informational/navigational-aid use and license data before any navigation-grade claim.

risks.riskTitle: Weather data error liability
risks.description: Forecasts are probabilistic and can differ from local conditions. Presenting forecasts as accurate or authoritative, or failing to show freshness/source, creates reliance risk.
risks.commercialImpact: Reliance and misrepresentation exposure; blocks accuracy claims.
requiredEvidence: Forecast evaluation in the target region
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits accuracy, 'official weather' and guaranteed-forecast claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Display provenance/freshness and carry the mandatory weather disclaimer.

risks.riskTitle: Remote monitoring and missed/delayed alert liability
risks.description: WATCH/FLEET monitoring depends on connectivity and cloud delivery. Alerts can be delayed or lost; no delivery guarantee exists. Copy promising continuous monitoring or guaranteed alerts creates safety-of-life expectations the product cannot meet.
risks.commercialImpact: Safety-of-life expectations create uncapped liability; no insurance or SLA evidence exists.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits guaranteed alerts, continuous monitoring, 24/7 and safety-of-life claims absolutely.
risks.potentialRemediation: Measure delivery, publish limits and explicitly disclaim alert guarantees.

risks.riskTitle: Cybersecurity failure liability
risks.description: A compromised HUB/PILOT could be steered, disabled or used to exfiltrate location data. No security controls, incident handling or insurance cover are evidenced; the control plane is currently unauthenticated.
risks.commercialImpact: Cybersecurity incidents can cause injury, data breach and regulatory action; no cover confirmed.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits security certification, 'hacker-proof' and 'secure by design' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Remediate the control-plane defects and obtain cyber liability cover before connected product sale.

risks.riskTitle: Unsafe steering behaviour liability (PILOT)
risks.description: A steering product can cause loss of control, collision or injury. PILOT's safety case, E-stop, motor isolation, takeover detection and independent verification are absent; it must not be offered or described as safe.
risks.commercialImpact: Uncapped catastrophic-injury exposure; the product cannot be sold or quoted.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits autonomous, unattended, remote helm, collision-avoidance and safety claims absolutely.
risks.potentialRemediation: Fund the staged safety programme; keep PILOT unsellable until independent verification.

risks.riskTitle: Software-update regression liability
risks.description: Updates can remove features, change behaviour or break compatibility. No release gating, rollback, change communication or update-conformity assessment exists; consumer law requires updates to maintain conformity.
risks.commercialImpact: Update defects can breach conformity and create liability; blocks update promises.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'future-proof', 'always up to date' and 'free updates forever' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Adopt an update policy with rollback and regression gates.

risks.riskTitle: Defective connected-product liability
risks.description: A connected device that fails, is misconfigured or is compromised can be defective under the revised PLD, which covers software and connected products. No cybersecurity or update evidence supports a defence.
risks.commercialImpact: No PLD/CRA evidence base; insurance cover unknown.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'safe connected device' and certification claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Complete CRA/PLD assessments and obtain liability cover before placement.

risks.riskTitle: Product liability insurance does not exist and premium is unknown
risks.description: No product liability, cyber or professional-indemnity policy, broker indication or premium quotation exists. Insurance premiums remain UNKNOWN; no coverage may be assumed, promised or implied to customers.
risks.commercialImpact: Any material claim would be uninsured; unbudgeted premium and possible uninsurability of PILOT.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'fully insured', 'insured to EUR X' and 'covered against' claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Obtain authorized broker indications for the intended product scope; keep premium UNKNOWN until then.

risks.riskTitle: Public brand-use conflict between MC-03 class-A allowance and MAREA NO-GO
risks.description: MC-03 allows public statements including 'MAREA is a product brand of EMBARCARTE' while the binding programme state is MAREA_PUBLIC_USE = NO_GO. The conflict must be documented, the stricter gate must prevail, and MC-03 evidence must not be silently rewritten.
risks.commercialImpact: A public brand claim could be an unauthorised trademark use and unfair commercial practice.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Public MAREA brand statements are prohibited; internal naming is allowed only in internal, non-published documents.
risks.potentialRemediation: Apply the stricter MC-14 gate, document the conflict and propose a formal MC-03 supersession without editing MC-03.

risks.riskTitle: Availability, stock, delivery and price claims are unsupported
risks.description: Nothing is in stock, no delivery capability exists and no price is approved. Claims such as 'available now', 'in stock', 'ships in X days', 'from EUR X' or any purchasable CTA would be false or misleading under the UCPD, the Price Indication Directive and Spanish consumer law.
risks.commercialImpact: False availability or price claims trigger consumer and unfair-competition liability and payment-provider risk.
requiredEvidence: Approved price list and stock record
risks.customerClaimImpact: All availability, stock, delivery, final-price and order CTAs remain prohibited while NOT_FOR_SALE and PRICE_APPROVED = NONE.
risks.potentialRemediation: Enforce the lifecycle-state CTA matrix and keep all prices labelled HYPOTHESIS_UNAPPROVED internally.

risks.riskTitle: Certification and approval claims (CE, RED, EMC, NMEA, marine) are unsupported
risks.description: No conformity certificate, notified-body opinion, NMEA certification, wheelmark or marine approval exists. Any 'CE marked', 'certified', 'approved', 'homologated', 'NMEA 2000 certified' or 'marine certified' statement is prohibited absolutely.
risks.commercialImpact: False certification claims are a market-surveillance and unfair-competition violation.
requiredEvidence: Certificate or declaration for the exact product
Claim record with evidence reference and approver
risks.customerClaimImpact: CE/RED/EMC/NMEA/marine certification claims are prohibited in every channel and locale.
risks.potentialRemediation: Encode the ban in the claims validator; allow only evidenced, product-specific claims after review.

risks.riskTitle: Performance, safety and interoperability claims are unsupported
risks.description: No comparative test, measured performance, sea trial or validated compatibility exists. Claims of accuracy, range, autonomy, collision avoidance, universal compatibility or 'works with any boat' are unsupported or absolutely prohibited.
risks.commercialImpact: Misleading performance/safety claims create unfair-competition and product-liability exposure.
requiredEvidence: Measured test report or sea-trial evidence
Claim record with evidence and approver
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'best', 'most accurate', 'guaranteed', 'fully autonomous', 'universal' and collision-prevention claims absolutely.
risks.potentialRemediation: Rewrite all public copy to the defined/tested/available distinction and require evidence per claim.

risks.riskTitle: Financial, profitability and investment claims are unsupported
risks.description: MC-13 scenarios are hypothetical and the restricted current case produces zero authorised revenue. No profitability, break-even, return, market-share or funding commitment may be presented as fact or as an investment promise.
risks.commercialImpact: Securities, investment and unfair-competition exposure; misrepresents a conditional model as fact.
requiredEvidence: Evidence that any figure is actual and sourced
Legal review before any financial statement
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits profitability, break-even, ROI, funding-round, investor and market-share claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Prohibit financial claims in the validator; keep all scenarios internal and labelled CONDITIONAL_HYPOTHETICAL.

risks.riskTitle: Customer counts, testimonials and market-share claims would be fabricated
risks.description: CUSTOMER_EVIDENCE = NONE, CUSTOMER_WTP_VALIDATED = false and no interviews or users exist. Any testimonial, customer logo, count, fleet size, rating or market-share statement would be fabricated and is prohibited absolutely.
risks.commercialImpact: Fabricated social proof is a serious unfair-commercial-practice violation.
requiredEvidence: Verified customer reference with written consent
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits testimonials, reviews, customer logos, counts, fleet size, ratings and market-share claims.
risks.potentialRemediation: Keep the testimonial/customer-evidence fields empty; no synthetic proof.

risks.riskTitle: Bilingual claim drift and channel leakage
risks.description: ES and EN claims can diverge in meaning, and prohibited claims can leak into packaging, manuals, proposals, app stores or SEO descriptions that are not covered by the website review. The claims contract must be bilingual and channel-explicit.
risks.commercialImpact: A compliant ES page and non-compliant EN page still expose the programme; channels are separately actionable.
requiredEvidence: Bilingual claim catalogue with semantic parity test
risks.customerClaimImpact: Any claim must match across ES/EN and channels; ambiguous translations are treated as prohibited.
risks.potentialRemediation: Enforce pair-level consistency in the machine-readable claims contract and validator.

risks.riskTitle: Company legal identity is missing from the site and legal pages
risks.description: SITE.legal owner/taxId/address/registry are incomplete, so the site cannot lawfully identify the seller, issue invoices or satisfy LSSI and consumer-information duties. This is a blocking operational gap for any commerce.
risks.commercialImpact: Blocks lawful commerce and invoice issuance; undermines every legal notice.
requiredEvidence: Verified registered name, tax ID, address and registry data
risks.customerClaimImpact: No public commercial surface may present EMBARCARTE as a seller until legal identity is published.
risks.potentialRemediation: Obtain the company registration data and publish it in the footer and legal pages.

risks.riskTitle: Existing shop/checkout presents sample purchasable commerce
risks.description: The current Angular site renders sample products, prices, cart and checkout flows from sample data. These are not MAREA products but they establish a live purchasable surface and a commerce expectation that is inconsistent with NOT_FOR_SALE and the absence of legal terms.
risks.commercialImpact: A live basket/checkout without approved products or terms invites consumer claims and payment exposure.
requiredEvidence: Approved consumer terms and legal identity
risks.customerClaimImpact: No MAREA product may be presented as purchasable; sample commerce must be clearly non-MAREA or disabled before MC-14 release evidence.
risks.potentialRemediation: Decide whether to disable the sample commerce or label it explicitly; do not publish MAREA products through it.

risks.riskTitle: Website brand and product claims are not governed by MC-14 gates
risks.description: The existing site mixes EMBARCARTE, OPEN-MARINE and nautical-technology claims (including automatic pilot and navigation technology) that were not written under the MC-14 claims policy. They require a read-only inventory and a future remediation plan.
risks.commercialImpact: Existing public copy can contradict the current NOT_FOR_SALE/trademark restrictions.
requiredEvidence: Website findings inventory with exact file/line references
risks.customerClaimImpact: Existing public claims must be inventoried and remediated before any MAREA publication; no fix is claimed in MC-14.
risks.potentialRemediation: Keep the D15 inventory, prepare MC-15 remediation, and do not modify the site in MC-14.

risks.riskTitle: Structured data, SEO metadata and app-store listings could assert availability or price
risks.description: JSON-LD, SEO titles/descriptions and app-store metadata can state product availability, price and ratings that are not approved. Search engines and marketplaces amplify such statements beyond the site.
risks.commercialImpact: Availability/price assertions in structured data or stores can be treated as binding offers.
requiredEvidence: Approved availability/price evidence before any Offer markup
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits Product/Offer structured data, price and availability fields until approved; app-store listings require the same evidence.
risks.potentialRemediation: Gate structured data on approved SKU/price/availability records; inventory current metadata.

risks.riskTitle: Unfair contract terms could waive or shorten mandatory consumer rights
risks.description: Draft terms could exclude liability, restrict remedies, impose disproportionate cancellation penalties or shorten the legal guarantee. Under Spanish consumer law and the Unfair Contract Terms Directive such clauses are void, and an aggressive limitation strategy can invalidate the template and trigger enforcement.
risks.commercialImpact: Void clauses remove the intended protection and damage enforceability of the whole contract set.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits terms that exclude liability, deny returns or shorten guarantees; disclaimers cannot cure statutory duties.
risks.potentialRemediation: Have counsel review every limitation clause and remove terms that conflict with mandatory rights.

risks.riskTitle: Website and marketing assert unproven ownership of the underlying technology
risks.description: Existing market copy presents EMBARCARTE as designing and commercialising open nautical technology and may imply ownership or an official relationship with OPEN-MARINE. The ownership chain is not cleared, so such claims are unsupported and could mislead.
risks.commercialImpact: Unsupported ownership claims create infringement and unfair-competition exposure and undermine due diligence.
risks.customerClaimImpact: Prohibits 'we own', 'our technology' and official-partner claims until the chain and any partnership are documented.
risks.potentialRemediation: Inventory current wording (D15) and replace with factual, limited statements after IP clearance.

risks.riskTitle: Recreational Craft and Marine Equipment Directive boundaries are unassessed
risks.description: Whether a MAREA product is a component covered by the Recreational Craft Directive, shipborne equipment under the Marine Equipment Directive, or an add-on outside both regimes has not been determined. No wheelmark or RCD/MED approval may be claimed, and the wrong classification could impose a conformity route that has not been planned.
risks.commercialImpact: A wrong boundary can add an unforeseen conformity route or support an unlawful marine-approval claim.
